ModMetaData.name: RWoM Core (Ability Framework)
ModMetaData.author: HUGINN
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RWoM Core — Ability Framework[/h1]
A shared integration layer for A RimWorld of Magic (Continued) and third-party add-ons.
[b]Included features[/b] [list] [*]Stable spell identifiers and definition lookup, so integrations can identify abilities independently of their displayed names. [*]Access to existing need-based resources, including mana and stamina: read current and maximum values, consume resources and add resources within their normal limits. [*]Read-only spell knowledge: learned abilities, ranks, upgrades and saved autocast settings supplied by the main mod. [*]Read-only class information for new progression paths, classic classes and hybrids, including progression stages where applicable. [*]Cast eligibility queries for manual actions and automatic AI use. These checks respect the main mod's restrictions without starting a cast or charging its cost. [*]External cast ownership registration: automatic RWoM casting can yield to another add-on without Core depending on that add-on. [*]Developer documentation, a compilable example and integration instructions for AI coding agents in the Docs folder. [/list]
[b]What Core does not do[/b] Core does not grant classes, abilities or mana by itself. A RimWorld of Magic (Continued) supplies the gameplay, grimoire, progression and casting. Core does not provide a general class-enrollment, spell-learning or cast-execution API. Knowledge and class queries require a compatible gameplay provider; integrations must handle its absence. Resources stored in hediffs are not exposed by the need-based resource API.
[b]Installation[/b] Load Harmony, then RWoM Core, then A RimWorld of Magic (Continued) and its class add-ons. Core is optional for the main mod, but an add-on that directly uses Core requires it. Install only one copy and restart the game after changing assemblies or load order.
[b]For developers[/b] Start with Docs/README.md, then Docs/API.md and Docs/Examples. AI agents should also read Docs/AGENTS.md. Use stable namespaced spell IDs, preserve unresolved saved IDs, and let the main mod own progression and normal casting payments.
